about: Each fact this skill states in its own words, with the page that states it and a phrase that page must still carry. No checker ships with this skill: re-check each by hand against its page; when one fails, re-read the page and correct the skill and this line together.

watch.value: deprecated; only used by legacy implementations

the LZ4 codec is deprecated in favor of LZ4_RAW

watch.value: If the file metadata is corrupt, the file is lost

watch.what: an INT64 nanosecond timestamp starts at 1677-09-21
a dictionary that grows too big falls back to plain encoding
watch.pattern: fall back to the plain encoding

the Rust parquet crate version the writer defaults were read at
the Rust writers default to no block compression

DataFusion writes zstd level 3 by default
DuckDB's default row group is 122,880 rows (URL pinned to 2.0: the stable path forwards in the browser only; move it when the version moves)
DuckDB's ideal file size is 100 MB to 10 GB (URL pinned to 2.0, as above)
the latest GeoParquet release
